visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with light brown hair and silver-rimmed glasses, wearing a black zip-up jacket over a grey t-shirt, stands in a car repair workshop. He gestures emphatically toward a silver sedan with its hood open. The background features workshop shelving, a wall-mounted fan, and various mechanical tools. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up of the car's engine bay. A hand enters the frame, pointing at specific engine components such as the plastic covers and fluid reservoirs, highlighting their clean condition. (3) The man stands next to a mechanic dressed in a black hooded jacket. They are looking at a pink and white paper invoice. The mechanic is seen rubbing his head. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the car's front wheel while it is elevated on a lift. The hand points through the silver spokes at a shiny, new brake disc. (5) The camera moves to show the undercarriage of the car. It is clean and free of oil residue. A small mechanical inspection probe with a blue handle is used to point out specific sealed joints and the oil pan area. (6) The man is now seated in the driver's seat of the car. He speaks directly to the camera, adjusting his hair and glasses. The background behind him through the window shows a blurred outdoor setting with greenery and later a highway overpass as the car is in motion. (7) Wide shots show the silver Mercedes-Benz coupe parked in the workshop and later driving on a paved road under overcast skies.
